featured_reviews.name: VANITA CHOUDHARI
featured_reviews.review_text:
My family has had two remarkable experiences with Dr. Kunal Shah in Kadamwadi, and I felt it was important to share them.
First Experience
My mother-in-law suffered a fall on 3rd March. We called the clinic around 8:00 PM, and the receptionist was extremely helpful in arranging an immediate consultation with Dr. Kunal Shah.
The clinic has an in-house X-ray facility, which helped speed up the diagnosis. As soon as the X-rays were reviewed, Dr. Shah promptly made the necessary decisions regarding treatment. He was precise, confident, and acted without delay. A plaster was applied immediately, and despite it being late in the evening, the doctor and his staff stayed until around 10:30–10:45 PM to ensure everything was completed properly.
The required medicines were prescribed, and we were advised to follow up after a month. Dr. Shah had also performed my mother-in-law's back surgery. The surgery went smoothly, and she was able to start walking the very next day.
Dr. Kunal Shah is exceptionally focused, highly skilled, and one of the finest orthopedic surgeons I have come across. After witnessing the quality of treatment provided to my mother-in-law, I became confident in recommending him to family and friends without hesitation.

Second Experience
A month later, my brother met with an accident. At Gurunanak Hospital's casualty department, we were advised that he would require surgery because one of his ankle bones had broken into several pieces (where a metal plate will be fixed inside).
As soon as I learned about the situation, I contacted Dr. Kunal Shah's clinic and shared the X-rays that had been taken at Hospital. After reviewing them, Dr. Shah informed us that the fracture could potentially be treated without surgery.
I immediately brought my brother to Dr. Shah's clinic. Once again, the receptionist was extremely helpful in coordinating everything. Dr. Shah examined him, applied a plaster, prescribed the necessary medicines, and clearly explained all the precautions and care instructions.
My brother remained in plaster for two months. Yesterday, the plaster was removed, and his ankle bone had healed successfully—without surgery.

I am sharing these experiences after several months because I wanted to describe the complete treatment journey and the final outcomes.

The clinic follows a first-come, first-served system, so waiting times can sometimes be an hour or two. However, I would sincerely advise patients to be patient because you are in very capable hands.

Dr. Kunal Shah has been an angel for us. We are deeply grateful for his care, expertise, and dedication.
Dr. Kunal Shah, thank you for everything. God bless you.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I took an appointment every time I visited, yet the doctor always seemed to be in a hurry and carried a very negative approach. There are two kinds of professionals: one who tells the truth while still motivating the patient to believe in recovery, and another who only talks in terms of giving up. Unfortunately, I experienced the latter.

As an athlete, hearing statements like “you will never be able to work out again” and “you will damage your body completely” was extremely demotivating. What made it worse was that my MRI showed two findings, but the doctor only noticed one—the second issue had to be pointed out by me during the next visit. This reflected a lack of attentiveness.

By God’s grace and with guidance from other competent and positive doctors, I am now healthy, fit, and doing everything I used to do. According to this doctor’s outlook, that would have been impossible—which clearly wasn’t the case. I also consulted a very renowned specialist who explained that everything was manageable and could be resolved.

A small piece of advice: a doctor should always speak the truth, but with hope and responsibility. Patients come seeking guidance, not hopelessness. To anyone reading this if you feel demotivated, do not lose heart. Take a second or even third opinion. The right doctor can make a world of difference.

This advanced procedure removes damaged bone and cartilage from the knee joint and replaces it with a durable artificial joint made from high-quality materials like metal alloys and medical-grade plastics.

🦵✨ Relief from Joint Pain with Viscosupplementation!

Struggling with arthritis pain and stiffness? 💭 Viscosupplementation is an advanced treatment that can help improve your joint comfort and mobility. During this procedure, a gel-like substance called hyaluronic acid is injected into the affected joint—most commonly the knee—to reduce pain and swelling. 💉

Healthy joints have cartilage that allows smooth movement, supported by natural lubrication. But in osteoarthritis, this cartilage wears down, causing bones to rub together and leading to discomfort. 😣 Viscosupplementation works by restoring this lubrication, acting as a cushion and shock absorber for better joint function. 🛡️

This treatment can help reduce stiffness, improve flexibility, and enhance your overall quality of life. 🌿 If joint pain is affecting your daily activities, this could be a great option to explore!

featured_reviews.name: Vinay Jumani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Dr. Kunal is an excellent doctor; very calm and reassuring. I had an accident and injured my left knee. It was in a bad shape, and completely swollen. Post MRI, it was found the I had a torn ACL and few more damaged muscles along with tiny meniscus also. Dr. Kunal suggested me 3 weeks of complete rest so that swelling reduces and some lotion is achieved in the knee instead of rushing in to a surgery. Post 3 weeks he operated on me and mobilized me the next day by giving a lot of confidence.  With his follow up plan and physiotherapy..I was able to walk in 2 weeks even though being overweight...he was constantly in touch with me over phone and guided me. It's been 3 months post surgery, and I am nearly there, being normal. He had set my expectations very clear so that I do not overdo or be scared of pushing myself. His post-OP protocol was a constant guide and chart to check my progress. I am really happy I went to him..

Thanks Dr. Kunal for being more than just a surgeon.
